A skilled deceiver who earns trust through performance, adopts any face needed, and turns a mark's own confidence against them.

SKILLS

COPY CAT

Once per scene, as your action, spend 1 Fabula Point to repeat the most recent action taken by another character this scene. You pay all costs as normal.

You cannot copy:

  • a Quirk, or anything derived from one
  • Champion or Villain unique abilities
  • Equipment actions
  • rituals, Projects, or anything outside a conflict scene
  • another character's Guise swap

DISTRACTION · SL max 2

When assisting in a Group Check, you may create a distraction that grants the leader a bonus equal to your (SL) on their final roll.

MASK OF IMPERSONATION · SL max 4

When unobserved by anyone outside your party, you may spend 1 FP to assume the appearance of a humanoid creature you have seen within the past two days. While disguised, gain a bonus equal to your (SL) on any checks made to convincingly impersonate that individual. The disguise lasts until you choose to drop it or until someone sees through it.

If the Guise you are wearing has a Tell, the impersonation carries it — you can look like the person, but you cannot suppress the Tell; the Innate Guise, which has no Tell, is the face to run a con in. Many Faces and this Skill stack rather than compete: the Perk grants the appearance, this Skill grants the performance (the +(SL)) and lets you impersonate without the Perk.

SECRET ACTION · SL max 3

Declaring a secret action uses your action for that turn. During your turn you may declare a secret action and specify a trigger condition. When the trigger occurs, you immediately perform the chosen action, interrupting all other actions until it is resolved. Gain a bonus equal to your (SL) on any checks related to your secret action. When you start your next turn you lose your secret action.

Example: You choose your action will be "Attack a target" and you will set the trigger to be "When an ally takes damage." So when an ally takes damage you will attack your target.

TRICK OR TREAT · SL max 4

Spend 2 IP and roll a 1d4 to concoct a potion with unpredictable effects. Choose your target before rolling to determine the result.

RollResults
1Recover SL × 10 hp and mp
2Recover from all status effects and gain 1 IP
3Inflict SL × 10 poison damage
4Inflict Poisoned and Enrage
